bg-shipka-pass.slogan: Shipka Pass – 30 km between Gabrovo and Kazanlak
bg-shipka-pass.story: Sustained elevation change, linked bends and open summit views. It also links naturally to Thracian Tomb of Kazanlak.
bg-shipka-pass.legalNote: Verify pass condition, surface quality and local closures. Specific flag: winter weather.

scenicChapters.title: Bulgaria Shipka Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 18 km this is Bulgaria Shipka Pass Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

kettle-moraine-road.title: Kettle Moraine Road

kettle-moraine-road.provenance: MANUAL SEED: every stop was entered by hand from a known position on the road. The distance is the seed figure, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces it. Altitudes are present only where they were known; the rest are null rather than zero.

scenicChapters.title: Kettle Moraine Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 29 km this is Kettle Moraine Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

kettle-moraine-road.story: A one-way ride of 115 km, Whitewater to Hartford - roughly 2 h 13 in the saddle. The stops in between: La Grange, Eagle and Dousman. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
